I received the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil as a free sample from BzzAgent in exchange for writing this honest, unbiased review. This cleanser stands out immediately for living up to the "Light" in its name. I have tried several other K-Beauty cleansing oils that, while effective, felt thick, heavy, or occasionally left a slight film that made me concerned about clogging pores. ​The incorporation of Centella also gives it a unique soothing factor that most standard oils lack. ​The key benefits of this cleanser are perfectly aligned with managing sensitive or reactive skin while achieving a deep cleanse. It effectively dissolves heavy makeup, stubborn eyeliner, and highly water-resistant sunscreens without any pulling or harsh scrubbing, making it the perfect first step in any double-cleansing routine. Because the formula is non-comedogenic and rinses flawlessly, it is less likely to contribute to congestion or breakouts compared to heavier, residue-leaving oils or balms. For someone with sensitive and acne-prone skin, finding a first cleanser that is both effective and genuinely soothing is a challenge, i would most definetly purchase this in the future. ​I would strongly recommend this product, especially to friends or family members who Struggle with redness or reactive skin after cleansing. ​It's a fantastic, high-quality product that prioritizes skin comfort without sacrificing cleansing power.

avis.titre: A New Favorite in My Skincare Routine!
avis.texte: I've tried quite a few cleansing oils, but this one immediately stood out. It's incredibly lightweight, almost water like, so it doesn't feel heavy or greasy on my skin. Even though it's oil-based, it melts away makeup, sunscreen, dirt, and excess oils effortlessly, and it doesn't sting around the eyes at all (a big win!). It's non-comedogenic too, so it dissolves sebum without clogging pores—my skin feels clean and balanced afterward, never tight or irritated. If you're new to oil cleansers or want something that feels fresh, light, and effective, this is an amazing choice. My skin looks clearer, feels softer, and my pores stay happier. Highly recommend!

As someone with sensitive skin, finding a cleansing oil that effectively removes makeup without causing irritation can be a challenge. The Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil has been a game-changer in my skincare routine. Infused with Centella Asiatica extract, known for its soothing properties, this cleansing oil gently melts away impurities, sunscreen, and even stubborn makeup without stripping the skin's natural moisture barrier. One of the things I appreciate most about this cleansing oil is its lightweight texture. Unlike some other cleansing oils that can feel heavy or greasy, this one emulsifies beautifully upon contact with water, rinsing away cleanly without leaving any residue behind. After using it, my skin feels clean, refreshed, and noticeably calmer, with reduced redness and irritation. Another standout feature of the Madagascar Centella Light Cleansing Oil is its minimalist ingredient list. Free from artificial fragrances, colors, and other potential irritants, it's a great option for those with sensitive or acne-prone skin. If you're looking for a gentle yet effective cleansing oil that won't disrupt your skin's delicate balance, I highly recommend giving this one a try.

avis.texte: to get straight to the point, this cleansing oil caused me to get pimples everywhere on my face, even areas where i never get pimples. i first got acne in 2022 and that was the worst it was UNTIL i purchased this cleansing oil. it does a great job getting rid of makeup i will say, but if you have acne-prone skin please reconsider getting this brand of cleansing oil. i woke up everyday with clogged pores and tiny pimples on my skin. my skin was so irritated.

This product does not remove all of your make up. Still have a lot of residue when I use my toner. Bought it because I have dry skin. Smells like a citronella candle, which is unappealing, but at least I should repel mosquitos afterward, lol.

I really don't understand these reviews that state it "removes even the most stubborn mascara." It doesn't remove the Too face Better than sex mascara. (pink tube) I'm returning this product today and going back to Dermalogica's pre cleanse.
just repurchased this! its my fave oil cleanser ive used, the only downside for me is when it gets in my eye it does burn and the scent is pretty strong for a face product

I just had to share how amazing my skin feels after using this combo! The cleansing oil melted away all my makeup effortlessly — even stubborn mascara — without stripping my skin. Then the cleansing balm came in like a spa treatment, deeply nourishing and leaving my face silky smooth. I finished with the hydration step, and wow… my skin has never felt this soft and dewy! The texture is buttery, the scents are subtle and calming, and the glow it leaves behind is just unreal. It feels like I just stepped out of a facial every time. Honestly, this trio completely transformed my skincare game — I'm obsessed!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleansing oil is a game changer! It gently melts away makeup and sunscreen without leaving any residue. My skin feels clean, soft, and hydrated after every use. Love the natural, lightweight formula and the beautiful earthy packaging - it's skincare that feels like self-care.
Feels like wax it's so thick- doesn't remove waterproof makeup or cleanse pores. Leaves a weird cast.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was hesitant to use and right to do so. After seeing the other product that had ingredients i was allergic too i looked at this one as well. Wouldn't you know it has damascena rose oil in it. Which serves no purpose. It also makes the scent so strong i can't even open it let alone use it. Strike 2 for this group of products. Should have provided an ingredient list.
Had high hopes because it is an oil cleanser and I take my makeup off with coconut oil often anyway. But it broke me out within three uses.

I really like this clenaser. I DO double cleanse, and I highly suggest double cleansing if you have struggled with acne for a long time. I do still break out, but theyve been smaller, less frequent, and easier to handle. I only use it at night and then I cleanse with an oil control gentle cleanser. It takes makeup off like a dream and I always feel nice and clean afterwards. If youre someone who has spent hundreds of dollars trying to find the perfect thing, the reality is this will not cure your acne, but it sure will help you find the balance to have a better chance at clearing it up if it is constant hormonal or bacterial acne.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Honestly not a bad cleansing oil. It does the job but does not go above and beyond like others I have used. My face doesn't feel incredibly clean after using this for a first step but it does at least remove most of the makeup. My favorite part is the packaging and how it can easily twist and lock for travel without having to worry about it spilling. Sensitive skin people will love this due to the texture and no scent

It's gentle, as mentioned, but it definitely would not remove makeup. This is a good every day cleansing oil, only to remove daily spf and moisturizer, but even as a daily it doesn't deeply cleanse. The oil is not thick, it's very lightweight. Scent is sweet, like a lemon pastry. I've tried better cleansing oils to remove makeup and sebaceous filaments. I've noticed that I have small pinkish red bumps on my face, I think it irritates my skin. When I started using this and I put my exfoliating toners on my nose (where I concentrate this oil more) my skin burns as if It's been irritated raw. It's good but it's not the best, I'd go for another one especially if you have sensitive skin.
Somehow I got rash and breakout after using it, maybe my skin is not suitable for it

I absolutely love how this makes my skin feel. It has a nice clean scent that's not heavy. Leaves the skin feeling smooth and hydrated. Comes in a simple clan packaging. This is great for that dry winter skin. I received this product free for my honest review.

I love the centella line from skin1004, the ampoule saved my skin, i got this and tried it, over all my skin feels nicer after, it did a good job getting all my makeup off, but the scent is so strong and irritating thay i cant keep it
The cleansing oil is gentle and lightweight. My skin felt refreshed not irritated from the ingredients. It has a gentle fragrance and worked well with my skin. I loved the product!
This was a decent product, it didn't have a overpowering smell, it did was it was intended to do for the most part
I'm loving this product so happy I got to try and review this it definitely removes my make up with out irritating my face especially eyes easy to use and apply I just keep it in my shower.

It effectively removes makeup and impurities without stripping my skin of its natural oils. My skin feels clean, soft, and supple after use. However, I'm not a huge fan of the scent - it's not overwhelming, but it's not my favorite either. Despite that, the benefits of this cleansing oil far outweigh the smell. I'd definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle yet effective cleanser
I've never had a bad reaction to any oil cleanser but this product broke my entire face out so badly. Definitely do a patch test
